गांव की शांत ज़मीन पर मंडरा रहा है अनजान शक्तियों का साया! 😱

जैकी श्रॉफ और शरद केलकर की अपकमिंग साइकोलॉजिकल हॉरर फिल्म Kaali Kheti का खौफनाक trailer आखिरकार रिलीज़ हो गया है।

यह फिल्म 20 November 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज़ होगी, जिसमें जैकी और शरद बाप-बेटे के किरदार में नज़र आ रहे हैं।

trailer में दिखाया गया है कि कैसे गांव की खेती वाली ज़मीन ही लोगों के लिए भयानक सपना बन जाती है और supernatural घटनाएं उनकी आजीविका को खतरे में डाल देती हैं।

Haris Imtiyaz Khan के डायरेक्शन और Sana Khan के प्रोडक्शन में बनी इस फिल्म में Neha Sargam, Virendra Saxena और Shaji Choudhary भी अहम भूमिकाओं में हैं।

क्या आप सिनेमाघरों में सस्पेंस और हॉरर से भरी इस कहानी को देखने के लिए उत्सुक हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय ज़रूर बताएं! 🎬👇

ctx.title: Kaali Kheti Trailer Review: Jackie Shroff & Sharad Kelkar’s Horror Drama Explores How Agricultural Land Turns Into A Field Of Nightmares
ctx.summary:
What happens when the land that feeds you becomes your biggest nightmare? That's what Jackie Shroff and Sharad Kelkar's next explores- Kaali Kheti trailer review.  
 The post  Kaali Kheti Trailer Review: Jackie Shroff & Sharad Kelkar’s Horror Drama Explores How Agricultural Land Turns Into A Field Of Nightmares  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Jackie Shroff and Sharad Kelkar will soon be seen in a horror film. The film will be released in theatres on November 20. On Thursday, a week before its grand theatrical release, the makers dropped the trailer. It promises an eerie, mysterious setting in a village. The plot centers on a father and son, played by Shroff and Kelkar.
The trailer shows a sparsely populated village and the eerie occurrences there. Jackie Shroff is seen telling Sharad Kelkar that he should have called him earlier if he was in trouble. Their conversation hints at a serious issue in the village and suggests that Sharad would not have called his father if the situation had not been beyond his ability to resolve.
We are then introduced to a world where fields of harvest turn into the villagers’ worst nightmare. Set against a chilling rural backdrop, the film explores a village living under the shadow of an unknown force, where the very land that sustains life becomes a source of terror. It promises to be a psychological horror film that places agricultural land at the center. This is quite an unconventional route for a horror film.
The trailer does not reveal much about the plot but leaves just the right amount of mystery. It sets the right tone for the film, with multiple supernatural elements lurking in the village. These supernatural elements also threaten the villagers’ livelihoods, making the stakes even higher. The trailer also features interesting conversations between the characters, who are not just frightened but are also trying to make sense of the occurrences around them. We hear them discuss the possibilities of illusions and dreams to explain what happens around them. Either way, Kaali Kheti seems to be an intriguing mystery-horror drama.
As for the performances, Jackie Shroff conveniently transforms himself into any role he takes up. He brings a distinctive screen presence to the eerie setup. Sharad Kelkar, who is known for his deep voice, brings a strong presence and gravitas to the plot. Their intriguing appearances hint at layered characters and a story filled with suspense, mystery, and psychological tension.
Written and directed by Haris Imtiyaz Khan and produced by Sana Khan, the film also features Neha Sargam, Virendra Saxena and Shaji Choudhary in pivotal roles. Produced under the banner of BlackCanvas Studio, Kaali Kheti is scheduled to release in theatres on November 20, 2026.
